source.title: Commit to Quality
source.description: I've been thinking about what to do with that hunk of metal and I think I've got the perfect thing for it. Give me just a few minutes here and I can whip it up for you.
source.objective: Watch Master Elemental Shaper Krixix craft your item.
source.completion:
There she is. Isn't she a beauty? Don't be fooled by how long it took for me to whip this bad boy up. I only made it LOOK easy. I assure you, this is a masterpiece.

I even think it's my finest work. Of course, everything I make is my finest work. Well, that was a fun distraction, but I've got to get back to work. See ya around.
